lines.text: The Well Line stays unrecorded. A clerical oversight. I make several each week.
Pump contract stamped. The aquifer clause is in Appendix F. I read it. Nobody else will.
The pylon faulted. A fault, not a person. I entered it as such. I entered it twice.
Foreman Orrin read your file. I would be careful about the word 'burden'.
A cull was recorded against your crew's name. I could not make it disappear. I tried.
